about.description: Orca is the ADE for working with a fleet of parallel agents. Run any coding agent with your own subscription. Available on desktop, mobile and remote runtime.
about.head: 90849ed

name: v1.4.227
body:
## UI / workspace
* fix(worktrees): never delete a folder git no longer tracks by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/25075
* fix(notifications): remove read macOS notifications from Notification Center by pane thread by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/28425
* fix(i18n): drop chat-mode keys removed from en.json in #28113 by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/28131

## Orchestration
* fix(orchestration): stop retried failed worker starts from piling up live agents by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/27795

## Agents / native chat
* feat(native-chat): each Claude/Codex chat gets its own permission mode by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/26116
* fix(native-chat): chats from before permission modes keep the mode they were running with by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/28099
* fix(native-chat): seed the chat permission default from Claude's and Codex's own arguments by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/28100
* feat(settings): move Permissions for new chats into the Chat page's Behavior section by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/28212
* fix(native-chat): store a chat's permission mode on its own, so a model pick can't reset it by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/28268
* feat(native-chat): require Codex 0.136.0 for chats by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/26684
* feat(native-chat): offer Codex Ultrafast as a speed choice by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/26962
* Re-land Claude per-account folders (#24434, #26405) with the upgrade and proxy fixes by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/26801
* Add "Copy sign-in link instead" for Claude accounts (STA-9912) by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/26990
* fix(native-chat): offer resume after restart for chats whose only work was in the background by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/27167
* fix(native-chat): resume large terminal conversations in a new native chat by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/29056
* Terminal header button: Resume in New Native Chat replaces Show chat view by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/27184
* fix(tab-bar): offer Resume in New Native Chat only while the tab's agent is running by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/27520
* Session History shows OpenCode, Grok, OMP and Pi chats as chats and refuses a second terminal writer by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/27183
* Session History: resume folder workspace chats in their own folder by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/27209
* Resume dialog: show a finished resume as a result, not a picker by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/27732
* Save a new chat's first message during create by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/26332
* fix(native-chat): settle a reply cut off by a server restart by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/26460
* Open a chat visual in its own tab instead of the sidebar by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/26728
* Let a Codex chat stop a command it left running in the background by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/26780
* fix(native-chat): preserve running subagent rows in long chats by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/26798
* A new Pi chat names the model it will run on its first frame by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/26821
* Keep Chat UI users with a Terminal default on the terminal, with a chat mode switch in the upgrade tip by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/26915
* Floating-workspace chats of every native-chat agent keep links in the folder they started in by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/26981
* Every agent reports its learned default model once, when a chat starts by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/26982
* Let a Grok chat list and stop the commands it left running in the background by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/27022
* Let a Codex chat stop a sub-agent from the background-tasks strip by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/27026
* fix(native-chat): a new chat's model and effort pickers match their first frame before the agent starts by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/27031
* Native chat: every agent launches through one composed launch path by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/27204
* Edit agent launch settings on the workspace host by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/26479
* One shared subagent tracker for Claude, Codex and Grok chat rows by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/27228
* Native chat: read one saved row per subagent (part 1 of 2) by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/27914
* feat(chat): host writes one saved row per subagent by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/27947
* feat(settings): move Chat UI's chat settings from Experimental to the Chat page by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/28050
* fix(tab-bar): native chat tabs show their recorded provider, not one guessed from the title by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/28082
* Replace chat upgrade switch with primary Enable Now button by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/28113
* Make Enable Now the full-width action in the chat upgrade tip by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/28199

## Remote server / SSH
* native chat: identify a paired device by its device id, never its credential by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/26777

## Browser
* Open links and window.open in Orca tabs the way Chrome does by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/26976
* Fix browser login popups and menu actions in native windows by @AmethystLiang in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/28474
* Auto-hide menu bar in web popups and re-layout when revealed by @AmethystLiang in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/28388
* fix(browser): agent bringToFront and activateTarget no longer take your keyboard (1/3) by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/28452
* fix(browser): agent keys and text go to the page, never into your terminal (2/3) by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/28453
* fix(browser): agent clicks give your keyboard back (3/3) by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/28454
* fix(browser): require a target for ambiguous keypress commands by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/28221
* fix(browser): refuse web pages on the agent-browser CDP proxy by @OrcaWin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/27415

## GitHub / source control
* Start AI commit messages from the same shell environment chats use by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/26808

## Performance
* perf(notifications): stop every Windows notification from freezing Orca by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/27731
* Skip reindexing unchanged transcripts on cold session list reads by @AmethystLiang in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/28798

## Mobile
* fix(native-chat): load long chats on the phone by keeping every update within its limit by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/28203
* fix(mobile): keep the chat where the reader scrolled to by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/28413
* fix(mobile): open Grok, OpenCode, OMP and Pi chats on the phone by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/27212

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/stablyai/orca/compare/v1.4.224...v1.4.227
